scope: pilot final postproduction visual QA; no global production model change
selectionReason: Both matched all three inspected case verdicts. Argon provided explicit header/turnip losses, separate late-character time ranges and geometric explanation for the corrected title area. Its observed batch price was about 1.6x Flash; for final review this modest absolute difference is accepted. This is a pilot judgment, not statistically demonstrated superiority.
limitations: One silent animation, three correlated output variants; no speech, lip sync, music, cuts, live camera or other generated content benchmark.
One request per model: latency is an observation, not a speed/SLA comparison.
Earlier 2.5 Flash review used a different prompt and per-clip requests: not a controlled old-vs-new comparison.
Model-proposed SRT style strings remain untrusted; do not execute them. The explicit ASS title safe area is verified, but proposed alternative styles were not rendered.
No automated approval, no changes to Nova, no accepted-media overwrite, no global GEMINI_MODEL change.
next: Integrate the selected model behind the postprod-only review setting and provenance/CAS/idempotency/budget guards.
Broaden controlled benchmark to existing generated clips with speech, audio mix and scene changes before production default acceptance.
